scenario: LCYC.6.1.2 — `different literals` means literal inequality by value, not just textual presence. A self-edge whose RHS emit pins the same literal the LHS where-clause matches is a real cycle and stays rejected with DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE. Pin: `A: kind == "enter" → emit A kind: "enter"` rejects; the literal-equality break only fires when the values differ.
rules_ds:
schema A scope logical:
    kind: String key

rule echo:
    A a where a.kind == "enter"
->
    emit A logical kind: "enter"
